profile.reading:
This registry entry is listed under the name Agricultural and Biological Engineering, attributed to Purdue University, at an address on South University Street in West Lafayette, Tippecanoe County, Indiana. That name and address match Purdue's Department of Agricultural and Biological Engineering, an academic department with its own faculty, laboratories, and instructional space on Purdue's West Lafayette campus.

Nothing in Purdue's published facilities information, department pages, or campus building directories describes a dedicated data center at this location. The name itself is an academic department name, not a facility name of the kind operators typically give to purpose built data center buildings, such as a building number, a campus abbreviation paired with a number, or a company brand name. The most likely explanation is that this point was captured in OpenStreetMap as part of a general campus mapping effort and labeled with the name of the nearest or most prominent building or department, rather than as a record of an actual dedicated data center.

Purdue University does operate central IT infrastructure and research computing resources elsewhere on its campus, but no public source ties that infrastructure specifically to this location. This entry is presented here as a likely campus mapping artifact rather than a confirmed data center, and no capacity or facility specifications are published for it because none appear to exist.
